text.text: One of the Wizard Armor exclusive parts. Its stat is the armor stat maille - it only carries that material's armor traits and never drags in a weapon trait.
Build it in the Part Builder with a blank pattern plus any craftable material (2 material units), or cast it from the fluid of 2 material units using a cast.

The three casts: gold cast (reusable), sand cast and red sand cast (single use). The gold cast is cast from 1 robe lace + 90 mB molten gold; sand casts can be molded from the gold cast, or pressed directly from sand / red sand in the Part Builder.
